diagnosis: TenantContextMiddleware extracts X-Tenant-ID directly from incoming headers and sets request.state.tenant_id without verifying that current_user belongs to that tenant. Route handler trusts request.state.tenant_id, allowing an attacker to inject any tenant's ID in X-Tenant-ID header and read their monthly financial metrics.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/analytics/monthly-revenue HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
X-Tenant-ID: 994
